description: Run the AI-DLC `incident-response` stage (operation phase) in isolation, without advancing the main workflow. Packages `/aidlc --stage incident-response --single`: the engine emits one run-stage directive for incident-response and its gate, the conductor runs it, then the single-stage run commits a synthetic-id pair and stops. The main workflow's Current Stage is never touched.
